title: TableConfig
description: TableConfig: Configuration settings for SQLite table operations and schema management.

TableName.description: The name of the table to operate on.

ConflictResolution.description: Conflict resolution strategy for handling data conflicts during Insert or Update operations. ConflictResolution: Defines SQLite conflict resolution strategies for handling data conflicts during Insert or Update operations.

IncludeBHoMGuid.description: Whether to include the BHoM_Guid column for object identification.

IncludeTimestamps.description: Whether to include timestamp columns for creation and modification tracking.

ColumnMappings.description: Custom column mappings from property names to column names.

ExcludedProperties.description: Properties to exclude from table schema when auto-creating tables.

AutoCreateIndexes.description: Whether to create indexes automatically on commonly queried columns.

BatchSize.description: Maximum number of rows to process in a single batch operation.

_bhomVersion.description: Optional version of BHoM used as part of automatic versioning and schema upgrades.
